categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in environmental protection water treatment systems and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. Key product lines include condensate water precision treatment systems, desalinated water treatment (including seawater desalination) systems, sewage treatment systems, and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. Additionally, it develops intelligent power station equipment and provides integrated design and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as high-tower resin separation for condensate water precision treatment, membrane and thermal coupling seawater desalination technology, and integrated hydrogen fuel cell system technologies including membrane electrode assembly, metal bipolar plates, fuel cell stacks, and system integration. It employs automated assembly lines for fuel cell stacks and advanced coating and manufacturing processes for core components. The water treatment systems are designed with PLC or DCS automatic control for full automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large power generation groups such as China National Nuclear Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, State Power Investment Corporation, National Energy Group, Huaneng Group, China Resources Group, Datang Group, and China Coal Group. The company serves nuclear power plants, thermal power plants, metallurgy, chemical industries, municipal sectors, and transportation vehicle manufacturers for hydrogen fuel cell engines. Overseas markets include South America, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant market presence in regions including East China, North China, Northwest China, South China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Central China. It also has international projects in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative such as Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on research, design, system integration, and assembly of water treatment and hydrogen fuel cell systems. It procures core components from suppliers but has developed in-house production capabilities for key fuel cell components like membrane electrodes and bipolar plates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating leadership in nuclear and thermal power water treatment markets, expanding hydrogen fuel cell engine system business as a second growth curve, and broadening into non-power industrial water treatment and municipal sectors. R&D focuses on membrane technology, system integration, fuel cell stack automation, low-platinum membrane electrode technology, and green hydrogen production technologies such as alkaline electrolyzer membranes. The company emphasizes innovation in modular, intelligent, and energy-efficient systems aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of water treatment system equipment and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems, including design, procurement, and construction contracts (EP, EPC, and BOOT models). The company also earns income from operation and maintenance services under BOOT contracts and from sales of integrated intelligent power station equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in condensate water precision treatment systems for nuclear and large thermal power plants, with relatively few competitors able to meet stringent nuclear power requirements. It holds a strong position in seawater desalination and hydrogen fuel cell engine system markets, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. Competitors include other specialized water treatment and fuel cell technology firms, but the company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 373.8 million, a 46.58% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.54 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets were about RMB 910.7 million, with a slight decrease from the prior year. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 5.21% of revenue. Cash flow from operating activities increased significantly by 625.37%. The company has a registered capital of approximately RMB 151.9 million and a workforce of 196 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies with independent intellectual property rights, high-quality and stable water treatment systems meeting stringent nuclear power standards, and advanced hydrogen fuel cell technologies including low-platinum membrane electrodes and automated stack assembly. Its integrated system solutions, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive service offerings provide customers with reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly products that support green energy transition and carbon neutrality goals.
